correctness.rationale: A generating set containing a base reflection can be normalized to that reflection plus rotations, so d(G)=d(A)+1 and pair extension reduces exactly to completion inside A. Completion of k prescribed rotations to d(A) generators is equivalent to the rank inequalities in every Sylow Frattini quotient. The k=1 and k=2 cases give all four adjacency types. Independent primewise counting gives N and R(a). For divisibility, each p-part of an active rotation is absorbed by the corresponding factor in R(a); the only delicate maximal-rank case gains one p from p^d-p, and d>=2 makes the valuation sufficient. The exact packaged replay enumerates every minimum generating triple and every graph edge for C9 x C3 and C3 x C3 x C5 and reproduces all predicted degree strata.

originality.rationale: The 2020 primary source poses the degree-divisibility problem. The later full-text rank-independence classification covers the special situation in which every noncyclic pair is adjacent but does not give the exact graph when that property fails. The new theorem classifies all pair failures for arbitrary odd abelian generalized-dihedral kernels, including non-elementary and mixed-Sylow cases, and derives exact degrees. Targeted searches found no equivalent formulas or stronger theorem implying them.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves an explicit published divisibility question on an infinite nonnilpotent family with unbounded minimum generator number, while simultaneously giving the entire minimum-size independence graph. The mixed-Sylow rank-(d-1) obstruction produces genuinely new degree strata absent from the elementary-abelian case, and the formulas remain exact for arbitrary invariant factors. This is a structural extension rather than a routine single-parameter computation.
